userStories.title: DB Migrations: tabella transfers, colonne from/to su transactions, vincoli saldo
userStories.description: As a system, I need a transfers table and updated transaction columns to support real-time account-based money flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Nuovo file supabase/migrations/20260221000001_create_transfers.sql che crea la tabella transfers con: id UUID PK, user_id FK auth.users, amount NUMERIC(12,2) CHECK > 0, date DATE, note TEXT nullable, is_recurring BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, frequency TEXT CHECK IN ('monthly','weekly','yearly') nullable, trigger_pac BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, from_savings_account_id UUID FK savings_accounts nullable, to_savings_account_id UUID FK savings_accounts nullable, to_investment_account_id UUID FK investment_accounts nullable, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
CONSTRAINT exactly_one_destination: (to_savings_account_id IS NOT NULL)::int + (to_investment_account_id IS NOT NULL)::int = 1
RLS abilitato su transfers: CREATE POLICY transfers_user FOR ALL USING (user_id = auth.uid())

Partial unique index transfers_recurring_dedup su (user_id, from_savings_account_id, COALESCE(to_savings_account_id,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid), COALESCE(to_investment_account_id,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid), date) WHERE is_recurring = true

Nuovo file supabase/migrations/20260221000002_add_account_fks_to_transactions.sql: ALTER TABLE transactions ADD COLUMN from_savings_account_id UUID REFERENCES savings_accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN to_savings_account_id UUID REFERENCES savings_accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

Backfill in 20260221000002: UPDATE income transactions SET to_savings_account_id = (SELECT id FROM savings_accounts WHERE user_id=t.user_id AND is_primary=true LIMIT 1) WHERE to_savings_account_id IS NULL
Backfill in 20260221000002: UPDATE expense transactions (non Investimenti/Risparmi, senza investment_account_id o savings_account_id) SET from_savings_account_id = primary account

Nuovo file supabase/migrations/20260221000003_add_balance_constraints.sql: ALTER TABLE savings_accounts ADD CONSTRAINT balance_non_negative CHECK (balance >= 0); ALTER TABLE investment_accounts ADD CONSTRAINT cash_balance_non_negative CHECK (cash_balance >= 0)
In src/types/database.ts: aggiungere interfaccia Transfer con tutti i campi della tabella
In src/types/database.ts: aggiornare Transaction aggiungendo from_savings_account_id?: string e to_savings_account_id?: string
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created 3 migration files: 20260221000001_create_transfers.sql (transfers table with RLS, exactly_one_destination constraint, recurring dedup unique index, perf indexes), 20260221000002_add_account_fks_to_transactions.sql (from/to savings_account_id columns + backfill to primary account), 20260221000003_add_balance_constraints.sql (balance >= 0 on savings_accounts and investment_accounts). Updated database.ts: Transaction now has from_savings_account_id? and to_savings_account_id?; added Transfer interface with all fields. Typecheck clean.

userStories.title: useTransfers hook: addTransfer e deleteTransfer atomici con rollback
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a hook to add and delete transfers atomically, updating account balances with rollback on failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Creare src/hooks/useTransfers.ts che esporta: transfers (array Transfer), loadTransfers(year, month), addTransfer(data), deleteTransfer(id), isLoading

addTransfer: (1) check client-side balance >= amount (savings o investment secondo from_savings_account_id), errore 'Saldo insufficiente su [nome conto] (disponibile: X€, richiesti: Y€)' se non sufficiente
addTransfer: (2) salva originalFromBalance, decrementa source balance
addTransfer: (3) INSERT in transfers, se fallisce → rollback source balance + toast.error
addTransfer: (4) incrementa dest account balance (savings o investment cash_balance), se fallisce → rollback source + DELETE transfer + toast.error
addTransfer: (5) se trigger_pac=true e dest è investment account → chiama pacExecutor callback (prop opzionale del hook)
addTransfer: toast.success 'Trasferimento registrato' (o 'Trasferimento + PAC eseguito' se PAC triggered)
deleteTransfer: recupera il transfer, inverte i balance updates (decrementa dest, incrementa source), poi DELETE il record; rollback se inversione fallisce
loadTransfers: query transfers WHERE user_id = userId AND date BETWEEN start_of_month AND end_of_month, ordine date DESC
Usare parseEuropeanDecimal e formatCurrency da useInvestmentAccounts.ts (non duplicare)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created src/hooks/useTransfers.ts: exports transfers[], isLoading, loadTransfers(year,month), addTransfer(data), deleteTransfer(id), setTransfers. addTransfer: fetch source balance, client-side check balance>=amount, decrement source, INSERT with .select('id').single() to get insertedId for rollback, increment dest (savings or investment cash_balance), PAC executor if trigger_pac. All failure paths rollback source balance + delete inserted transfer. deleteTransfer: fetch transfer, decrement dest, restore source, DELETE record. Uses formatCurrency from useInvestmentAccounts (no duplication). Typecheck clean.

userStories.title: Ricorrenti: copia dei transfers ricorrenti con aggiornamento saldo

Se trigger_pac=true sul transfer: dopo l'aggiornamento balance, eseguire executePacRules() per il conto investimento destinazione

userStories.notes: Extended copyRecurringFromPreviousMonth in recurring.ts: now returns {transactionsCopied, transfersCopied}. Added section 2: queries recurring transfers from prev month, INSERTs each with new date (day-clamped), skips 23505 duplicate silently, atomically decrements source balance + increments dest (savings or investment cash_balance) with rollback on each step, executes PAC via executePac() if trigger_pac=true. Passare i transfers filtrati per mese a computeMonthDelta nelle iterazioni mensili
